description: This file defines a utility class 'BeanUtils' for working with Java Beans, providing methods to instantiate the utility and retrieve property values via reflection.

classes.name: BeanUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for accessing bean properties via reflection.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of BeanUtils.

methods.name: getPropertyValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified property from a given bean object via reflection.

methods.name: getPropertyDescriptor
methods.description: Helper method to get the PropertyDescriptor for a given property name on a bean class.
